question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **" Buffett".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is** "Buffet".**
 
• It means a meal where people serve themselves food that is arranged on a table.
 
• **Example -** *The dinner includes a buffet and drinks.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Awesome - **Impressive

 
 
• **Example -** *We had an awesome task ahead of us.*
 
 
 
• **Pauper - **A very poor person.
 
 
• **Example -** *A pauper begs on road.*
 
 
 
• **Mischief **- Bad behavior especially of a child.
 
 
• **Example -** *Tarun is a mischievous boy.*
